name: How long does it take to paint a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to paint a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Painting an average-sized bathroom typically takes one to two days. The actual painting process involves cutting in edges and applying two coats, which takes several hours, but dry times between coats are critical in humid rooms. Surface preparation—such as cleaning soap scum, patching drywall, sanding, and taping around tile and vanities—often requires half a day before applying any paint. Cooler indoor temperatures or high humidity can slow down drying, so allowing adequate drying time before applying the second coat ensures a durable finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting a bathroom typically takes 1 to 2 days, allowing adequate time for prep work, two coats, and proper drying between layers.
